items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: I played a little bit of Tommy Dorsey’s solo, and I kept looking at him and he just didn’t react at all.

ctx.x: Because I had memorized all the solos out of that, and I played a little bit of Tommy Dorsey’s solo, and I kept looking at him and he just didn’t react at all. Maybe he thought I was putting him on.
